top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs the founding PROTAC concept (Crews and Deshaies, the one element on which every B014 supporter agrees) with Liu's base editing, where a biological process, deaminated-base repair, was turned into a defined chemical reaction that was independently reproduced and quantified, and the adenine editor required inventing new enzyme chemistry. Within B014 alone I would prefer Ciulli to Handa as third name because his ternary-complex structural work made degrader design rational, so P001 follows and then P002; P004 omits the best-supported degrader field, and no award ranks last.
